_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: Backend-owned A2UI with the toolkit validate->retry loop (src/agents/a2ui_dynamic.py, injectA2UITool=false). Prompts are unique to this slug (a2ui-recovery/suggestions.ts, mirrored in harness d5-a2ui-recovery.ts PROMPTS). The heal retry is told apart from attempt 1 by systemMessage, not sequenceIndex, so it does not depend on per-process match counts.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: Staged on turnIndex, not hasToolResult/toolCallId: the Antigravity Go harness never sends role:"tool" messages (see PARITY_NOTES.md). turnIndex is the assistant-message count: +2 per tool round trip, +1 per text answer.

fixtures._comment: HEAL — inner render_a2ui RETRY (attempt 2+): matched by the fix-it block the toolkit's recovery loop appends to the sub-agent system prompt. VALID surface (Column + two Metric tiles) -> paints (declarative-metric x2). Listed BEFORE the attempt-1 leg: at the same position aimock serves the first-registered untagged candidate, and turnIndex 0 (the inner request's count) only keeps this leg's match key distinct from the attempt-1 leg's.

match.userMessage: Chart the Antigravity quarterly revenue board and repair a malformed first render.

fixtures._comment: HEAL — inner render_a2ui attempt 1: structurally INVALID (root references the missing child 'missing-metric') -> the validate->retry loop rejects it and retries with the errors in the system prompt.
